subject: Finovexa POC — preflight: hands-on workshop, load window & site access
messages:
From: Claire Dumas <claire@finovexa.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finovexa POC — planning kickoff and hands-on session

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro — we are excited to get a POC scheduled. Our team wants a hands-on working session that includes: prompt review, routing overview, and a short load test to validate throughput under our 400–600 concurrent user window.

High-level asks:
- 2–3 hour hands-on workshop with prompt review and routing/playbook walkthrough
- 60-minute dedicated load test window (we’ll bring synthetic traffic)
- Onsite preferred (NYC office) but we can do hybrid if required
- Visitor access and badge instructions for 4 external guests

Are you available the week of Jan 18? If you can send a short agenda and any pre-work (prompt set + data sample), that will help our security team sign off.

Thanks,
Claire Dumas
Head of Product, Finovexa
claire@finovexa.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dumas <claire@finovexa.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finovexa POC — planning kickoff and hands-on session

Hi Claire — great to hear. Week of Jan 18 works for us. Two quick options I can offer now:

Option A: Wed, Jan 20, 10:00–13:00 ET (hands-on) + 14:00–15:00 ET (load window)
Option B: Fri, Jan 22, 09:30–12:30 ET (hands-on) + 13:30–14:30 ET (load window)

Prefer onsite in NYC as well — we can set up a hybrid room if you have remote participants. I attached a draft agenda (POC_Agenda_v1.pdf) with the proposed run of show and a short pre-work checklist (prompt examples + smallest data slice we need).

Notes / asks from our side:
- Please confirm attendee names and company emails so we can pre-clear badges.
- For recording / screen sharing: we typically record the walkthrough for internal training, but will not record customer prompt content unless you explicitly approve. Please let us know your preference.
- For the load window: what concurrency and request profile will you use? We need a small warm-up window 10 minutes before the full test.

I’m looping in Monica for room booking and Marcus from infra for the load test coordination.

Best,
Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai

Attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + pre-work checklist)
From: Claire Dumas <claire@finovexa.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finovexa.com
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 12:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Finovexa POC — planning kickoff and hands-on session

Thanks Ava — we’ll take Option A (Jan 20).

Attendees (onsite):
- Claire Dumas (claire@finovexa.com)
- Omar Singh (omar@finovexa.com)
- Priya Menon (priya@finovexa.com)
- Jordan Hale (jordan@finovexa.com)

Concurrency profile for load window: ramp to ~500 RPS over 10 minutes, sustain for 30 minutes, then ramp down. We’ll provide the synthetic traffic harness and an IP allowlist if needed.

Security notes: we need a signed site access form for visitors and confirmation about whether session recording will be enabled — security prefers no recordings of raw prompt/response payloads unless redacted. I’ve attached our site security contact sheet and a short checklist.

Claire

Attachment: Finovexa_Site_Security_Contact.pdf
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Dumas <claire@finovexa.com>
Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Finovexa POC — planning kickoff and hands-on session

Monica / Marcus — forwarding Claire’s confirmation. Action items: 
- Monica: please reserve Conference Room E (12-person) on Jan 20 10:00–15:30 ET to include load window, and request hybrid AV so remote participants can join. Need visitor badge clearance for 4 guests — can you confirm the visitor pre-clear process and whether the lobby needs advance notification?
- Marcus: please reserve an infra slot for 14:00–15:00 ET for an external-driven load test. We’ll need an isolated test pool (no other customer traffic) and a warm-up period. Can you also confirm the estimated token throughput and whether we should toggle any batching settings?

Checklist to include in calendar invite: run of show, attendee list, map to the meeting room, who to contact for badges (Security Desk ext. 7421), and a statement re: recording (customer approval required).

Quoted for context:
> From: Claire Dumas <claire@finovexa.com>
> Attendees (onsite): Claire, Omar, Priya, Jordan
> Concurrency profile: ramp to ~500 RPS over 10 minutes, sustain 30m

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.
Ava

All set: Conference Room E reserved on Jan 20 10:00–15:30 ET. AV/Hybrid setup is confirmed (Polycom + HDMI + Zoom room). Marcus is assigned for the load window and will coordinate the isolated test pool.
